name: map-fix-round
question: Three failures measured on the first full generation of the 12 maps. (1) FLOATING DIORAMA: bowerdeep and sanctum came back as an isometric island of terrain with an earth cross-section under it, water round it and empty cream background in the corners — the standard isometric-pixel-art idiom, and not a walkable map. y1/y2/y3/y4 test a full-bleed clause. (2) SCALE: tools/artverify measured buildings at 250-355 native px against an 85-140 bar; 'none wider than about a twelfth of the picture' did not land, so y2-y5 swap the fraction for a comparative the model can actually count. (3) ROUTES DREW BUILDINGS: r4 got a fortress and r2 a cottage even though the skeleton said 'no buildings' — y5 moves the prohibition to the front of the string and names the specific things. y6 is the unmodified shipped Hearthollow prompt as a control, so any regression from the new clauses is visible.
